gap.heading: Why it exists
gap.sub: 300M+ Indians have no bureau score. They do have a phone. And on that phone, transactional SMS carries the financial behaviour signal that makes them underwritable: salary credits, EMI payments, UPI activity, and lending history, all without a single document.
hero.heading: The transactional SMS inbox, read as a live financial behaviour profile.
hero.sub: A consent-based module that reads the applicant's transactional SMS and extracts income, obligations, lending activity, spending, and liquidity — in real time, from the messages already on the device. No documents, no bureau wait.

integration.heading: Integration
integration.lede: Consent-based. The applicant grants SMS access during onboarding, and the profile returns in real time. Only transactional SMS is read — personal messages are never parsed or stored.
